resources.string: Includes settings, collection rules, download and watch records, keyframes and check-in data. Excludes videos and login cookies. Password encryption is available when exporting. Search aliases and translation history are included.
Off by default. Android schedules work when the battery is not low; timing may vary. The first eligible run can start immediately.
Local retention (plus the latest recovery snapshot)
Local versions are removed on uninstall or clearing app data. Choose a folder for an additional copy of each backup. External copies are kept until you delete them; restore with Import backup.
The last backup failed. Existing versions are retained.
Saved locally, but the folder copy failed. Choose a writable folder again.

Restore data from %1$s? This replaces included settings and records. The file is validated and a recovery snapshot saved first. Pause all downloads. Unfinished records restore as paused; video files and current login are preserved.
Delete the local version from %1$s? External copies are kept.
Pause downloads and wait for pending tasks before restoring.
Operation failed. Check storage space, folder access and backup integrity.
A restore was interrupted. Library access is paused and the recovery snapshot is retained. Check available storage, then retry to recover the state before the restore.
